blind.description: A stylized, hand-painted garden bush or shrub composed of three conjoined rounded mounds. The surface is textured with layers of leafy clusters featuring serrated leaf fringes. Leaf colors transition from bright chartreuse and lime-green tips at the top of each mound down to richer mid- and dark-green tones underneath. The geometry sits flat directly on the ground with no visible trunk or stems.
blind.from_above: A rounded, roughly triangular cluster displaying three distinct mounds, each crowned with a rosette of bright lime-green leaf textures surrounded by darker foliage.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and about 2.5 feet wide.
